name: Verbatim Transcript
description: Preserve a transcript-focused record with minimal summarization.

sections.title: Transcript
sections.instruction: Reproduce the transcript in chronological order, retaining speaker labels and timestamps when available. Do not paraphrase.

sections.title: Uncertain or Inaudible Passages
sections.instruction: List uncertain, incomplete, or inaudible passages and their timestamps. Do not guess missing words.

sections.title: Corrections
sections.instruction: List explicit corrections made during the conversation or supplied in transcript metadata.
